d: Kronos Fusion Energy — investment thesis, approach, and milestones. Design-and-simulation stage; not an offer of securities.
The Kronos plan: construction from Q2 2027, first-of-a-kind ~2030, test burner ~2032, commercial fleet ~2036.
How Kronos de-risks fusion: simulation-first, products on the path to power, breeder-first, open and honest.
